capabilities: chat with locally installed agent CLI providers as subprocesses
check provider readiness, CLI version and model discovery in settings
display a live provider capability matrix (images, forking, rewind, steering)
meter per-turn token usage by day and session
archive and reopen conversations locally with all saved turns
disambiguation: Despite the name, its default provider is Oh My Pi, not Claude; the claude, codex, grok, opencode and pi providers were removed in 1.9.0.
extras: Desktop only (spawns subprocesses via Node APIs); can coexist with upstream Claudian using separate storage folders; installable via BRAT; detailed security/network disclosures; session transcripts and usage logs stored in the vault under .super-useful-claudian/.
intentEvidence: An independent fork of Claudian by Yishen Tu.
motivation: The author forked Claudian to make Oh My Pi the default provider, keep DeepSeek Harness as the second, and add a local transcript archive, provider readiness panel, token meter and other enhancements.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to drive locally installed AI agent CLIs as chat collaborators, or to check whether those CLIs are installed, working and configured.

relations.evidence: An independent fork of Claudian by Yishen Tu.
OMP (Oh My Pi) provider, now the default harness.
Upstream's maintained DeepSeek Harness provider (deepseek) remains as the optional second.

requires.name: at least one provider CLI (omp or dsh) installed locally
DeepSeek account or API key for the DeepSeek Harness CLI
subscription or API access required by the chosen CLI

summary: Fork of Claudian that runs Oh My Pi and DeepSeek Harness agent CLIs as chat collaborators inside the vault, with readiness checks, a capability matrix and token usage tracking.
